codexPort.name: ai-agent-engine-codex
codexPort.goal: 在 Codex 中提供 AE 风格的软件工程工作流入口。
codexPort.runtimeBoundary: Codex 使用 skill 承载工作流；/ae-* 是兼容标签，不是 OpenCode config.command 式动态 slash command。已启用 skill 是否出现在 / 或 skill 搜索中取决于当前 Codex App。
codexPort.runtimeEntry: Resolve aeEntry once using ae-help/references/runtime-entry.md; project wrapper first, current-user dispatcher only when absent. Help binds the successfully invoked entry.

skills.name: ae-help
skills.target: 查看当前能力与模型适配
skills.purpose: 查看本地 AE for Codex 已安装的工作流入口、使用边界，以及 model compatibility、模型中立适配和 reasoning_effort 元数据边界。

skills.name: ae-init
skills.purpose: 按 minimal、ae-core 或 full profile 初始化 AGENTS.md 与 AE 文档，并可预览 Codex 指令优先级和嵌套候选。

skills.name: ae-ideate
skills.purpose: 围绕模糊目标生成候选方向、取舍、风险和下一步澄清问题。

skills.name: ae-brainstorm
skills.purpose: 澄清需求、范围、碰撞洞见、验收标准和开放问题，必要时沉淀需求文档。

skills.name: ae-claude-code
skills.purpose: 将本地 Claude Code CLI 作为受控外部 worker，用于只读分析、审查或 patch 候选方案；Codex 仍负责审查、应用和验证。

skills.name: ae-prd
skills.purpose: 在实现计划前沉淀 WHAT 层面的产品需求、范围、验收标准和待定问题。

skills.name: ae-design
skills.purpose: 在 PRD 和实现计划之间沉淀架构、API、数据、UI/UX、测试、安全、观测和非功能设计契约。

skills.name: ae-lfg
skills.purpose: 从需求澄清到计划、实现、审查、验证和交付证据的完整流程。

skills.name: ae-plan
skills.purpose: 在编码前生成可执行的实现计划，包含单元、文件、测试、风险和回滚。

skills.name: ae-constitution
skills.purpose: Create or update durable AE project principles that plans, reviews, tasks, and gates can inspect.

skills.name: ae-tasks
skills.purpose: Turn an approved AE plan into dependency-ordered task IDs with file paths, validation tasks, and parallel-safety markers.

skills.name: ae-work
skills.purpose: 在 Git/工作区安全检查后执行计划或窄范围任务，并保留验证证据。

skills.name: ae-refactor
skills.purpose: 为行为保持型重构生成计划、风险、验证和回滚策略。

skills.name: ae-review
skills.purpose: 执行分层代码或文档审查，按严重度优先输出问题。

skills.name: ae-doc-humanize
skills.purpose: 把结构化或生硬内容改写成人类可读文档，同时保持事实不变。

skills.name: ae-doc-structure
skills.purpose: 把散乱文本整理成结构化需求、计划、决策、检查清单或交付文档。

skills.name: ae-frontend-design
skills.purpose: 按现有前端栈、设计输入和视觉基准执行前端设计与界面实现。

skills.name: ae-web-app
skills.purpose: 实现由 ae-web-forge 统一路由后的前端或轻量全栈 Web 流程，并结合现有仓库技术栈、浏览器验收与交付检查。

skills.name: ae-web-forge
skills.purpose: 作为统一入口执行前端/Web 四问题路由，选择 ae-frontend-design、ae-web-app 和 ae-test-browser 等 Codex-native skills，并限制最多 3 轮返工。

skills.name: ae-backend
skills.purpose: 基于仓库中的接口、服务、数据和权限契约实现后端行为。

skills.name: ae-debug
skills.purpose: 围绕构建失败、运行时异常、UI 问题和接口故障执行系统化排查与验证。

skills.name: ae-reverse-engineering
skills.purpose: 对用户自有或明确授权的二进制、移动端、取证、兼容性或本地训练工件执行防御性逆向分析；先确认范围、工件来源和证据边界，不自动安装工具或注册 MCP。

skills.name: ae-task-loop
skills.purpose: 固定成功标准，围绕探索性修复、环境搭建或遗留问题循环验证直到通过或明确阻塞。

skills.name: ae-tdd
skills.purpose: 围绕明确行为执行先失败测试、最小实现、回归验证和重构。

skills.name: ae-test-browser
skills.purpose: 使用真实浏览器执行 UI 流程、截图、控制台和网络验收。

skills.name: ae-test-api
skills.purpose: 在后端改动后选择相关接口、验证契约与风险路径，并记录脱敏的 API 测试证据；认证冒烟缺引用时生成可填写 UTF-8 请求配置模板，不替代浏览器验收或本地运行安全门。

skills.name: ae-sql
skills.purpose: 生成、审查或执行 SQL。默认只读；写入和生产操作必须显式确认。

skills.name: ae-swagger-parser
skills.purpose: 摘要或过滤 Swagger/OpenAPI JSON/YAML 规格，不调用业务接口。

skills.name: ae-markitdown
skills.purpose: Convert lightweight local files such as HTML, CSV, TSV, JSON, YAML, XML, text, and Markdown into Markdown without fetching remote URLs.

skills.name: ae-static-server
skills.purpose: Serve a local static file or directory for quick browser preview; use --dry-run to plan the URL without starting a process.

skills.name: ae-handoff
skills.purpose: 沉淀当前任务状态、文件、命令、结论、阻塞点和下一步。

skills.name: ae-work-report
skills.purpose: 基于 Git 历史、当前未提交变更和已有报告生成日报、周报或指定范围工作总结。

skills.name: ae-prompt-optimize
skills.purpose: 把用户目标改写为更可执行、边界更清晰的 Codex 提示词。

skills.name: ae-save-experience
skills.purpose: 把本次问题、决策、命令、验证和注意事项沉淀为项目经验。

skills.name: ae-skill-creator
skills.purpose: 创建或更新 Codex skill，遵循本地 skill-creator 规范。

skills.name: ae-skill-audit
skills.purpose: 只读审计外部 agent/skill 仓库，提炼可适配的 AE skill 改进或新增建议。

skills.name: ae-agent-creator
skills.purpose: 创建 Codex 可使用的代理提示、UI 元数据或委派模板；不声称 OpenCode 代理自动注册。

skills.name: ae-update
skills.purpose: 从指定 Git 仓库更新当前用户的全局 AE for Codex runtime、personal plugin 与 Cursor skill 副本，需要网络和 Git 操作确认。

skills.name: ae-language
skills.purpose: 切换本地 AE skill 列表显示语言为中文、英文或双语。

commands.name: recovery
commands.purpose: Inspect bounded resumable artifacts in one docs root; exclude navigation and immutable pages, expose completeness and path bases, and never infer registered project/branch identity.

commands.name: task-analyze
commands.purpose: Suggest bounded source candidates or plan units with dependency and parallel-readiness checks; immutable document pages are read-only evidence, never writable worker ownership.

commands.name: init
commands.purpose: 按可选 profile 初始化 AGENTS.md 与 AE 文档；安全更新受管区块，并提供只读嵌套/优先级诊断。

commands.name: check-ae-artifacts
commands.purpose: 检查 docs/ae 中 PRD、计划和其他 AE 产物 frontmatter 的基本合规性。

commands.name: check-design-contract
commands.purpose: 检查 docs/ae/designs/**/design.md 设计契约的 frontmatter、必需章节、稳定 ID、显式省略维度、映射表和一致性字段。

commands.name: check-memory-knowledge-contract
commands.purpose: 验证 docs/08-ai-memory/00-registry.json 的声明式记忆元数据、证据关系、路径安全和目标文件完整性。

commands.name: ae-memory-index
commands.purpose: 审计短记忆入口和专题体积；旧入口无损分片默认只预览，显式写入必须提供当前源哈希。

commands.name: ae-memory-search
commands.purpose: 独立的有界字面关键词检索，返回记忆路径、行号和短摘录；历史分片需显式选择，不改变声明式关系查询。

commands.name: ae-memory-query
commands.purpose: 只读检索已登记的 Markdown 记忆；至少指定 topic、path 或 relation 之一，未登记内容不会被扫描。

commands.name: ae-docs-maintain
commands.purpose: 分类审计记忆、开发历史、导航和滚动台账；超限内容无损分页，正式文档和证据不自动拆改。

commands.name: ae-docs-append
commands.purpose: 向专题、开发历史和滚动台账追加有界记录，自动生成不可变分片；预览后应用须核对源和记录两项哈希。

commands.name: ae-docs-search
commands.purpose: 有界检索相关文档，自动跟随托管分片，返回续查路径、页号和行号；默认不扫描正式和归档证据。

commands.name: ae-knowledge-map
commands.purpose: 输出已声明的记忆到 AE 产物关系图，并为每条边保留 declared provenance 和证据路径。

commands.name: ae-knowledge-query
commands.purpose: 按路径和方向查询已声明的文档关系；不推断反向关系或源代码依赖。

commands.name: ae-graph-build
commands.purpose: Build a bounded shallow dependency graph with content fingerprints, completeness and truncation diagnostics; generated document pages are excluded unless explicitly selected, and no snapshot is persisted.

commands.name: ae-graph-query
commands.purpose: Query the shallow dependency graph by path or keyword and report freshness metadata.

commands.name: claude-delegate
commands.purpose: 检查或调用本地 Claude Code CLI，默认用于受控分析和 patch 候选方案，不自动写入活动工作区。

commands.name: review-contract
commands.purpose: Generate a deterministic AE review contract with selected reviewers, target coverage, and optional evidence-ledger record.

commands.name: task-brief
commands.purpose: Extract one AE implementation unit from a plan into a file artifact for low-context handoff.

commands.name: review-package
commands.purpose: Write a task or branch review bundle with a complete changed-file inventory and optional bounded impact graph; document-page exclusions affect only advisory impact.

commands.name: evidence
commands.purpose: Read or write lightweight AE evidence ledger records under docs/ae/evidence.

commands.name: markitdown
commands.purpose: Convert a bounded local lightweight file to Markdown with explicit row, column and output truncation diagnostics.

commands.name: static-server
commands.purpose: Serve a local static file or directory for browser preview.

commands.name: report
commands.purpose: Generate a bounded self-contained HTML report or Git-friendly Markdown report from local JSON or Markdown evidence.

commands.name: issue
commands.purpose: Manage bounded worktree-local AE issues with pagination and owner-aware local write locks; not a distributed tracker.

commands.name: skill-audit
commands.purpose: Audit every distributed AE skill and its maintenance mirror, or recheck a pinned external skill watchlist without rewriting AE skills.

notes: /ae-* 是兼容标签；Codex 中可靠触发方式是 skill 名称、显式 $ae-* 调用或自然语言请求，例如“用 ae-work 执行这个计划”。支持的 Codex App 版本也可能在 / 或 skill 搜索中显示已启用 skills。
涉及 Git 写入、网络、依赖安装、数据库写入、生产环境或破坏性操作时，必须按 Codex 审批规则执行。
OpenCode 的 config.command 动态 slash command、agent registry、session navigation 和全局规则注入不是当前 Codex 项目级插件能力。
ae-graph-build / ae-graph-query now provide a shallow JSON graph with freshness evidence; this still does not port the full OpenCode graph schema, SQLite storage, sharding, or preview UI.
ae-merge-branch 暂不作为 Codex skill 暴露；Git merge 类写操作需等待 ae-work 的 Git 证据链和授权边界进一步增强。
ae-chrome-devtools 不照搬动态 MCP 注册；Codex 中通过现有 Browser、Playwright 或 DevTools 可用工具路由，并由 ae-test-browser 记录证据。

Spec Kit is used as a workflow reference for constitution, requirement checklist, task breakdown, and cross-artifact analysis patterns; this project adapts those ideas into AE skills without vendoring the Specify runtime.
